latest_release.body:
## 1.16.3 (November 25, 2026)

### NOTES:

* builder/null: DSA (`ssh-dss`) SSH keys are no longer supported following the update to `github.com/hashicorp/packer-plugin-sdk` `v0.6.14` and `golang.org/x/crypto` `v0.59.0`. Configurations that set `temporary_key_pair_type = "dsa"` or use a DSA key in `ssh_private_key_file` now fail validation; use an `ed25519`, `ecdsa`, or `rsa` key instead.
  External plugins are affected once they adopt the same SDK or `golang.org/x/crypto` versions.
    [GH-13748](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13748)
    [GH-13754](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13754)

### BUG FIXES:

* command: restore file and directory completion for commands that accept paths.
    [GH-13733](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13733)
* core/hcl2: use the overridden source name for `packer_build_name` (and
  `PACKER_BUILD_NAME`) in builders, provisioners, and post-processors.
    [GH-13723](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13723)
* provisioner/powershell: upload the full environment variable file on every
  retry so scripts no longer run without their `environment_vars` after a
  transient upload failure.
    [GH-13735](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13735)
* sbom: fix a crash when scanning Debian archives with negative member sizes
  (GO-2026-6905).
    [GH-13755](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13755)

### SECURITY:

* deps: bump `github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4` to `v4.1.9` in Packer and `v4.1.6`
  in the plugin tester to address denial-of-service and panic issues when
  parsing JWKs, JSON, and CBC-HMAC data (GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q,
  GHSA-4w3g-jfj2-cw2q, GHSA-vvm8-gf78-28g4).
    [GH-13737](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13737)
    [GH-13741](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13741)
    [GH-13748](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13748)
* deps: bump `go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk` and `go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace`
  to `v1.47.0` in Packer and the plugin tester so `AttributeValueLengthLimit`
  can no longer be bypassed (GHSA-q7gw-24fr-5p69).
    [GH-13743](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13743)
    [GH-13748](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13748)
* deps: bump `github.com/containerd/containerd/v2` to `v2.4.2` to fix a crash
  caused by malformed digests in subject-annotated descriptors
  (GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f).
    [GH-13754](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13754)

### IMPROVEMENTS:

* build: update Go to `1.26.11`.
    [GH-13748](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13748)

### DEPENDENCIES:

* deps: bump `github.com/hashicorp/packer-plugin-sdk` to `v0.6.14`.
    [GH-13754](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13754)
* deps: bump `golang.org/x/crypto` to `v0.59.0`, `golang.org/x/net` to
  `v0.63.0`, `github.com/klauspost/compress` to `v1.20.5`,
  `github.com/go-openapi/runtime` to `v0.33.0`, and
  `github.com/go-openapi/strfmt` to `v0.27.0`; update other dependencies in
  Packer and the plugin tester.
    [GH-13748](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13748)
    [GH-13754](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13754)
* deps: bump `github.com/andybalholm/brotli` to `v1.2.8`.
    [GH-13739](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13739)

### INTERNAL:

* ci: upload logs from failed acceptance test runs.
    [GH-13747](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13747)
* ci: disable Go test result caching for acceptance tests, install the Amazon
  plugin before they run, and isolate the plugin directory in plugin
  acceptance tests.
    [GH-13749](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13749)
    [GH-13753](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13753)
* ci: disable the JIRA sync workflow and remove the issue migrator workflow.
    [GH-13748](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/pull/13748)
* test: use a CycloneDX fixture in the HCP SBOM acceptance tests and add a
  live-scanner SBOM acceptance test.
    [GH-13750](https://github.com

detail.readme:
# Packer [![License: BUSL-1.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-BUSL--1.1-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Build Status](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![Discuss](https://img.shields.io/badge/discuss-packer-3d89ff?style=flat)](https://discuss.hashicorp.com/c/packer) ===

Packer is a tool for building identical machine images for multiple platforms from a single source configuration. Packer is lightweight, runs on every major operating system, and is highly performant, creating machine images for multiple platforms in parallel. Packer supports various platforms through external plugin integrations, the full list of which can be found at https://developer.hashicorp.com/packer/integrations. The images that Packer creates can easily be turned into [Vagrant](http://www.vagrantup.com) boxes. ## Quick Start ### Packer There is a great [introduction and getting started guide](https://learn.hashicorp.com/tutorials/packer/get-started-install-cli) for building a Docker image on your local machine without using any paid cloud resources. Alternatively, you can refer to [getting started with AWS](https://developer.hashicorp.com/packer/tutorials/aws-get-started) to learn how to build a machine image for an external cloud provider. ### HCP Packer HCP Packer registry stores Packer image metadata, enabling you to track your image lifecycle. To get started with building an AWS machine image to HCP Packer for referencing in Terraform refer to the collection of [HCP Packer Tutorials](https://developer.hashicorp.com/packer/tutorials/hcp-get-started). ## Documentation Comprehensive documentation is viewable on the Packer website at https://developer.hashicorp.com/packer/docs. ## Contributing to Packer See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) for best practices and instructions on setting up your development environment to work on Packer. ### Contributing to Documentation **Important:** Packer documentation has moved to the [`hashicorp/web-unified-docs`](https://github.com/hashicorp/web-unified-docs) repository. To contribute documentation changes: - Make contributions directly to the `web-unified-docs` repository - See the [Updating Documentation section](https://github.com/hashicorp/packer/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#updating-documentation) in CONTRIBUTING.md for detailed instructions ## Unmaintained Plugins As contributors' circumstances change, development on a community maintained plugin can slow. When this happens, HashiCorp may use GitHub's option to archive the plugin’s repository, to clearly signal the plugin's status to users. What does **unmaintained** mean? 1. The code repository and all commit history will still be available. 1. Documentation will remain on the Packer website. 1. Issues and pull requests are monitored as a best effort. 1. No active development will be performed by HashiCorp. If you are interested in maintaining an unmaintained or archived plugin, please reach out to us at packer@hashicorp.com.
